evals.prompt: 帮我把这个 Notion 页面导出成 Markdown：https://www.notion.so/acme/Weekly-Sync-1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef。输出到 docs/weekly-sync.md，图片下载到 docs/media，并把 Markdown 里的资源路径改成 /media/文件名。不要把 token 写进代码里。
evals.expected_output: Uses notion-to-md with file export plus media download, keeps the token in NOTION_TOKEN, and reports the markdown path plus media directory.
expectations: Uses notion-to-md instead of a hand-written block renderer
Keeps the Notion token in an environment variable
Configures media downloading and rewrites paths with transformPath
Produces a markdown file path and a media directory path

evals.prompt: 我的 pnpm 项目里要加一个 scripts/export-notion.mjs，传 pageId 和 output path 就能把 Notion 页面导出成 md 文件。请沿用现有 Node 风格，依赖用 notion-to-md v4 方案。
evals.expected_output: Adds a reusable script that matches project conventions and exports a page to markdown using notion-to-md and @notionhq/client.
expectations: Reuses the repo's package manager and existing style
Creates a reusable script or CLI rather than a one-off snippet
Writes markdown to a file via DefaultExporter or equivalent notion-to-md workflow

evals.prompt: 给我一个最小可运行的命令行方案，把 Notion 页面 URL 转成 Markdown 直接打印到 stdout，我要接到别的 shell pipeline 里。尽量少废话，但要提醒我前置条件。
evals.expected_output: Provides a minimal stdout-oriented notion-to-md flow that avoids noisy stdout logging and mentions integration prerequisites.
expectations: Accepts a Notion page URL and extracts the page id
Prints markdown to stdout without extra non-markdown output
Mentions the Notion integration, token, and page sharing prerequisites
